title: The German Modal Verbs
explanation: German modal verbs are a specific group of auxiliary verbs used to express necessity, possibility, permission, or ability. The six primary modal verbs are dürfen, können, mögen, müssen, sollen, and wollen. These verbs fundamentally change the mood or intent of a sentence by modifying the main verb, which almost always appears in the infinitive form at the very end of the clause.

examples.example: Ich kann heute leider nicht kommen.
Wir wollen am Wochenende wandern gehen.
